description: OCR a screenshot locally and return the text a user would see, line by line with confidence and position. Use it to see what actually rendered when you do not know what to expect.

image_base64.description: Base64 PNG or JPEG, if there is no file path

image_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPEG screenshot on this machine

region.description: Only read this part of the screenshot (pixels from the top-left corner)

name: read_text
title: Read the text visible in a screenshot
